name: x402 CLI Access with radius-cli
query: Access this Radius testnet x402-gated endpoint once from the terminal. I have a funded local radius-cli wallet. Do not create a Node project or JavaScript script.
context: The user wants a one-off paid request to an existing x402 endpoint. They explicitly want a terminal flow and already have a funded local radius-cli wallet. The endpoint returns x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED headers and supports Radius testnet.
expected_behavior: Uses radius-cli wallet x402 rather than the legacy curl/cast reference or viem app-client flow
Uses RADIUS_HOME scoped to the current project or agent and RADIUS_NETWORK=testnet
Runs radius-cli wallet x402 <verb> <url> with an explicit --x402-threshold display-unit limit
Uses --json for machine-readable output when the user asks an agent to execute it
Uses -y only after the URL, network, and threshold are explicit
For non-GET requests, passes headers with -H and body data with -d
Does not create a package.json, Node project, JavaScript script, manual typed-data files, or cast signing flow
success_criteria: Command shape is radius-cli wallet x402 <verb> <url>
Command includes --x402-threshold and explains the amount is display units, not raw 6-decimal units
Command includes -y for non-interactive execution only with an explicit threshold
No raw private key is requested, logged, or passed as a CLI argument
No command uses cast wallet sign, CAST_ACCOUNT, or manual EIP-712 JSON generation
Network uses Radius testnet through RADIUS_NETWORK=testnet or equivalent radius-cli configuration
The flow can be run from an arbitrary project directory
